Definition: Chattush, the name of four or five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hattush = "assembled"; 1) a descendant of David, apparently one of the sons of Shechaniah, in the 4th or 5th generation from Zerubbabel; 1a) a man who returned with Ezra; maybe same as 1 above; 1b) a man who returned with Zerubbabel; maybe same as 1 above; 2) son of Hashabniah who helped repair the walls of Jerusalem with Nehemiah
